name: Grutt' n Stadl
kurzbeschreibung:
Welcome to **Grutt' n Stadl** in **Tirol**!

Discover the heart of **Tirol**’s hospitality in our cozy **Grutt' n Stadl**. Whether you’re craving a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fresh **Apfelstrudel**, or a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**, our rustic charm and warm atmosphere make every meal an experience.

After your feast, explore the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**—from the majestic **Nordkette** above **Innsbruck** to the serene **Achensee**. Let us be your home away from home in the Alps!

**Grutt' n Stadl** – Where tradition meets taste in the heart of **Tirol**.
